Indian Ocean, the third largest ocean, bounded by Asia to the north, Africa to the west, and Australia to the east, and recognized as the warmest ocean on Earth, which contributes to the formation of many cyclones

Southern Ocean, also known as the Antarctic Ocean, which encircles Antarctica and is the fourth largest oceanic division, with its boundaries generally defined by the Antarctic Convergence where cold, northward-flowing Antarctic waters meet warmer subantarctic waters

Arctic Ocean, the smallest and shallowest of the world's five major oceans, located around the North Pole and largely covered by sea ice throughout the year, playing a crucial role in regulating global climate patterns
